en: Illustrated maritime postcard showing the ocean liner RMS Celtic of the White Star Line at sea. The large black-hulled ship with two buff-colored funnels steams through choppy water under a pale sky. Promotional text for the White Star Line and the ship's specifications appear in blue lettering, and the artist's signature, Montague Black, is visible in the lower right corner.
